appearances.snippet: But I am starting to look at Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s schedule because Charlie (Charlie Kirk) came back from Korea. verification.notes: Reuters reporting and Charlie Kirk's September 8 show confirm his immediately preceding Korea/Japan trip and his return to broadcasting. Available sources do not establish the exact late-September-7/early-September-8 landing time or the asserted California-to-Arizona sequence, so only part is verified.
